primary.F3: paired |kappa_hat_{B-F3}-kappa| - |kappa_hat_B-kappa| per root (seed-mean marginals; positive = full B better), exact two-sided sign test (ties removed)
primary.F5: same, full B vs B-F5s (generic coupling + higher-order removed together)
primary.family: Holm over exactly these two tests, alpha 0.05
primary.ci: paired root-cluster bootstrap 95% CI of the mean difference (2,000 resamples, seed 0)
primary.cohort: every new root whose four fixed-q0 edit outcomes (original, A, B, A+B) are all VERIFIED or CERTIFIED (any kappa class); kappa class reported, never used to include/exclude

secondary: B-F5q (HO only), B-F2, B-F4, B-V0, B-U, A, C, SF on the same metric (exploratory, Holm across the secondary family)
scene binary NLL / calibration of original and edited scenes
same-endpoint order choice and margin (where decided)
omission necessity on verified full repairs
strict TOP1 executed success: A/B/C/SF/geometry vs G+M (separate planner-assisted protocol)
D feasibility and blocker identity on complete masks
minimal_meaningful_effect: mean paired kappa-error reduction >= 0.05 with positive majority of roots
stopping: fixed roster and budget only; never on p-values

models.calibration: frozen P10d snapshot tau / threshold per checkpoint; no recalibration

constraints: no retraining, no recalibration, no model-conditional filtering, zero planner/IK/teacher calls in inference
